title: A merge trial step that fails fetching from an external host is a trial-host fault reported upstream, not a red head
description: A fixture head whose build fetches from an unresolvable host goes through the real merge writer and control plane: the build step reruns once, then the trial records a trial-host fault naming the host, the head is neither refused nor reworked, and for a non-Graphyard install the fault is filed once to the upstream install, or raised as one attention line, never into the managed repository.

steps.name: A network fetch failure reruns once, then is a trial-host fault reported upstream
